paragraphs: Smart Parking Limited sells car park management technology and parking services from offices in the United States, United Kingdom, New Zealand, Germany, Denmark, Switzerland and Australia. The company states over 30 years of experience in the industry and says it manages thousands of car parks for clients worldwide. A Managed Services division operates and manages car park spaces using Automatic Number Plate Recognition and Licence Plate Recognition technology, which can be combined with Pay on Foot technology.

Systems listed on the homepage include a mobile app and back-office management system for parking compliance and enforcement. Vehicle detection sensors are described as technology designed to pick up the usage of individual parking spaces. Mobile patrols are offered for bay enforcement, new site installs and peak occasions. A car park management system with Pay & Walk machines is offered as a payment method for motorists.
The about page names priority sectors that include retail, commercial property, transport and local government. Smart Parking Limited has been listed on the Australian Securities Exchange since 2011.

quote.text: We have over 30 years experience in the industry and manage thousands of car parks for clients worldwide.
